Person noun stays main noun entry. celebrate/celebrated share an old Latin root but are not made from celebrity, so they are not_family. Note: celebrated (= famous) is close in meaning. celeb (informal) is in the Oxford and Cambridge learner dictionaries; added to lexicon_supplement as a noun.
ceremonial = ceremony + -al (y to i). ceremonious (very polite and formal) is rare and left out.
